data.name: Holiday Inn & Suites Leon Plaza Mayor by IHG
data.address: Blvd A. López Mateos Poniente #2619, Villa del Juncal, 37180 León de los Aldama, Gto., Mexico
data.description:
Set in the financial district, this modern hotel is 2 km from shopping at Plaza Mayor and 32 km from Guanajuato International Airport.
Relaxed rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living/dining areas and kitchenettes. Kids age 18 and under stay at no extra charge with a parent. Room service is offered.
Parking and an airport shuttle are complimentary. Other amenities include an informal 24-hour restaurant (kids age 12 and under eat free), a lobby bar and a convenience store, as well as a gym and an indoor pool. Coin-operated laundry facilities are available.
